name: Placement Portal
brief: Build a web portal for the college Training and Placement Office (TPO). Students maintain profiles and resumes, companies post drives and jobs, students apply, and the TPO tracks applications, shortlists and offers with an admin dashboard and reports. Email notifications for new drives and status changes. Past placement records from spreadsheets must be migrated. Team of eight; target go-live by mid-January for the placement season, about eleven weeks.

tasks.name: Set up development environment and CI/CD pipeline
Implement user authentication and profile module
Implement company portal and drive posting

risks.title: Authentication security gap
risks.cause: Developer designs authentication without threat modeling
risks.event: Security test reveals credential bypass vulnerability
risks.effect: Module must be redesigned and retested, delaying related development
risks.response: Conduct a threat model workshop before T09 and allocate time for security review

risks.title: Design‑development timing clash
risks.cause: UI wireframes are not signed off before developers start coding
risks.effect: Rework of front‑end components pushes back multiple development tasks
risks.response: Lock wireframe approval date and enforce a no‑start rule for T09‑T11 until T05 is complete

risks.title: Single‑person developer bottleneck
risks.cause: Only one developer is assigned to core portal features
risks.event: Developer is unavailable for several days due to illness
risks.effect: All core development tasks slip, extending the schedule
risks.response: Cross‑train a second developer on the core modules and keep a buffer in the plan

risks.title: Stakeholder‑driven scope creep
risks.cause: TPO requests additional interview‑scheduling feature after specs are signed
risks.event: New feature is added to the functional specification
risks.effect: Extra development and testing effort pushes go‑live date later
risks.response: Formal change‑control process with impact assessment before any new requirement is approved

risks.title: Late production server access
risks.cause: College IT team processes server provisioning requests slowly
risks.event: DevOps cannot obtain production environment credentials on schedule
risks.effect: Deployment and post‑deployment monitoring are delayed
risks.response: Submit access request in week 1 and arrange a temporary cloud environment as fallback

risks.title: Email template quality issues
risks.cause: Email notification templates are created without functional testing
risks.event: Emails are sent with broken placeholders during UAT
risks.effect: Fixes and retesting add days to the testing phase
risks.response: Create test cases for all email templates and run them in a staging environment before T14 is completed

risks.title: Data migration character errors
risks.cause: Migration script does not handle special characters in legacy spreadsheets
risks.event: Past placement records become corrupted after import
risks.effect: Data cleanup effort delays admin dashboard readiness
risks.response: Run a pilot migration on a sample set, validate all fields, and add character‑escaping logic

risks.title: CI/CD pipeline not ready
risks.cause: DevOps work on pipeline overlaps with start of core development
risks.event: Developers cannot push code to shared repo because pipeline is incomplete
risks.effect: Development tasks are blocked, extending their durations
risks.response: Complete T08 before T09 starts and lock the pipeline as a gate for code commits

risks.title: Designer workload overload
risks.cause: Same designer is tasked with UI wireframes and email template design
risks.event: Design deliverables miss their planned dates
risks.effect: Delayed hand‑off to developers for both UI and email modules
risks.response: Allocate a second designer for email templates or stagger the design tasks to avoid overlap
